caller_script: The indoor blower on the Carrier system you installed this January has stopped working. I need to file a warranty claim.
The name is {name}, and the account number is {account}.
Does the installation warranty cover the part and labor, and would I owe a diagnostic fee?
Please schedule the warranty diagnostic for Monday afternoon if you have an opening.

knowledge.reference_answer: Because this Meridian-installed Carrier system was installed less than two years ago, it is within Meridian's 2-year labor warranty, and registered Carrier parts have 10-year coverage. Meridian registers every installed unit within 30 days. If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee; otherwise the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies.
